def calculate_unavailable_time(N: int, arrival_times: List[int]) -> int:
    total_unavailable_time = 0
    current_time = 0

    for T_i in arrival_times:
        # Calculate the time until the bridge becomes available again after lowering
        if current_time <= T_i:
            current_time = T_i
        else:
            current_time += (current_time - T_i) % 60
        
        # Raise the bridge
        current_time += 60
        
        # Calculate the time for boats passing through if any are waiting
        if len(arrival_times) > 1 and T_i != arrival_times[-1]:
            next_arrival = min(T_i + 20, arrival_times[arrival_times.index(T_i) + 1])
            boats_waiting_time = next_arrival - current_time
            if boats_waiting_time >= 20:
                total_unavailable_time += boats_waiting_time
                current_time = next_arrival
    
    # Add the time for lowering the bridge
    total_unavailable_time += 60
    
    return total_unavailable_time

def min_bridge_unavailability(N, arrivals):
    bridge_available = 0
    total_unavailability = 0
    
    for arrival in arrivals:
        # Calculate the time needed to lower the bridge if necessary
        if arrival > bridge_available:
            unavailability = max(0, (arrival - bridge_available) + 60)
            total_unavailability += unavailability
            bridge_available = arrival
        
        # Boat crosses the bridge
        bridge_available += 20
        
        # Calculate the time needed to raise the bridge after the boat passes
        if bridge_available < arrival + 20:
            total_unavailability += (arrival + 20 - bridge_available)
            bridge_available = arrival + 20
    
    return total_unavailability

    total_unavailability = 0
    
    for arrival_time in arrival_times:

        current_time = max(current_time, bridge_up_to_time)
        
        # Calculate the start time for the boat to enter the bridge
        boat_start_time = current_time
        
        # Update the current time to when the boat leaves the bridge
        current_time += 20
        
        # Update the bridge up to time considering the raising time
        bridge_up_to_time = max(bridge_up_to_time, current_time + 60)
        
        # Calculate the total unavailability time for road traffic
        total_unavailability += (current_time - boat_start_time)
        
        # Ensure the maximum waiting time does not exceed 30 minutes
        if arrival_time - current_time > 3 * 60:
            return -1
    
    return total_unavailability

def minimum_unavailability(N, arrival_times):
    # Initialize variables
    current_time = 0
    last_raised_time = -1
    total_unavailability = 0
    
    for arrival_time in arrival_times:
        # Calculate the time the bridge needs to be raised
        needed_time = max(current_time + 60, last_raised_time + 60)
        
        # Check if the bridge is not ready yet
        if arrival_time > needed_time:
            # Bridge needs to be raised
            total_unavailability += needed_time - current_time
            current_time = needed_time
        
        # Boat passes through the bridge
        current_time += 20
        last_raised_time = current_time
        
        # Ensure the bridge remains up for the next boat if it's soon to arrive
        if N > 1:
            next_arrival = arrival_times[1]
            if next_arrival <= current_time + 20:
                continue
            else:
                # Lower the bridge after the current boat has passed
                total_unavailability += next_arrival - current_time
                current_time = next_arrival
                last_raised_time = -1
    
    return total_unavailability

            total_time += 20

    current_time = 0
    next_lift_time = 0
    bridge_up = False
    total_unavailable_time = 0

            next_lift_time += 60
        
        # Calculate the time the bridge needs to be up

            total_unavailable_time += (next_lift_time - current_time)
            current_time = next_lift_time

        # Raise the bridge
        current_time = next_lift_time
        next_lift_time += 60
        bridge_up = True
    
    # Lower the bridge after the last boat passes
    total_unavailable_time += (current_time - next_lift_time + 60)
    
    return total_unavailable_time

def calculate_bridge_unavailability(N, arrival_times):
    total_unavailability = 0
    current_time = 0
    bridge_raised = False
    
    for T_i in arrival_times:
        # Calculate the time until the bridge becomes available again after lowering
        if bridge_raised:
            current_time += 60
        
        # Wait for the bridge to become available if necessary
        if current_time > T_i:
            current_time = T_i
        
        # Raise the bridge
        current_time += 60
        bridge_raised = True
        
        # Calculate the time the boat spends on the bridge
        if T_i + 20 <= current_time:
            total_unavailability += 20
        else:
            total_unavailability += (current_time - T_i) + 20
        
        # Lower the bridge immediately after the boat passes
        current_time += 20
        bridge_raised = False
    
    return total_unavailability
